metadata.title: MINO Solutions — Digital Solutions
metadata.description: Web design, digital transformation and content strategies for companies that want to grow on the internet.

hero.title:

digital presence

hero.desc: We design, develop, and optimize your digital ecosystem. High-performance websites, process transformation, and content strategies that convert visitors into clients.

services.title: Everything your business needs to grow digitally
services.desc: We combine design, technology, and strategy to build a digital ecosystem that works for your business.

s1.title: UI/UX Design
s1.desc: Clear, intuitive, and attractive interfaces that connect your brand with your customers from the first click.

s2.title: Web Development
s2.desc: Professional websites built from scratch or with WordPress, optimized for performance and conversion.

s3.title: Web Optimization
s3.desc: We turn slow sites into performance machines. Technical SEO, speed, and accessibility in one service.

s4.title: Digital Transformation
s4.desc: We modernize how your company operates: digital tools, automation, and more efficient processes.

s5.title: Content Strategy
s5.desc: We build your social media presence with content that communicates, connects, and converts.

cta.title: Don't know where to start?
cta.desc: Tell us about your project and we'll recommend the best solution, no strings attached.

process.title: A clear process, no surprises
process.desc: From idea to launch with a proven methodology and constant communication at every stage.

p1.title: Diagnosis
p1.desc: We analyze your business, goals, and audience to understand what digital solution you really need.

p2.title: Strategy & Design
p2.desc: We define the architecture, visual design, and content plan. We present prototypes before developing.

p3.title: Development
p3.desc: We build your solution with clean, optimized code ready to scale. Fast iterations with your feedback.

p4.title: Launch & Support
p4.desc: We publish with full performance, SEO, and accessibility testing. We support you after the launch.

cases.title: Real results, not promises
cases.desc: Each project is a digital transformation story. Over 90% improvement in performance, SEO, and accessibility.

case1.desc: Ecosystem of 4 interconnected news platforms for Salem, Oregon and Clark County, Washington. Scalable, automated infrastructure built with WordPress and PHP.

case2.desc: All-in-one platform with Marketplace, crypto Wallet, decentralized social network, and chat. A financial ecosystem built for everyday life.

case3.desc: Premium hair care brand: visual identity, full WooCommerce e-commerce, and Wompi payment gateway with electronic invoicing.

case4.desc: Institutional digital platform for El Salvador's National Center for the Arts (CENAR). Student artwork gallery and educational resource library.

packages.title: Solutions tailored to your digital stage
packages.desc: From complete web presence to social media strategy. Choose the package that best fits your business goals.

pkg2.sub: Digital optimization for companies that want to operate better on the internet

pkg1.sub: Complete digital presence: web, transformation and content in a single package

pkg3.sub: Strategy and growth in social networks to connect with your audience

about.title: Accessible technology that makes your business grow
about.desc: At MINO we believe that digital transformation should not be complicated or inaccessible. We design simple, effective and scalable solutions that allow companies to adapt to the digital environment progressively and sustainably.

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: To be a strategic ally in the digital transformation of companies, offering reliable solutions that strengthen their online presence.

vision.title: Vision
vision.desc: To become a benchmark in digital solutions for growing businesses in the region, driving innovation and business development.

cta.title: Your next client is looking for your business on the internet
cta.desc: Don't let the competition get ahead of you. Contact us today and in less than 24 hours we will present you a personalized proposal for your business.
cta.note: Response in less than 24 hours · No obligation · First consultation free
